payload: Preferred safety/performance design: do NOT cache a namespace verdict across saveJournal calls. Preserve full filesystem revalidation on every save, but within one validation pass resolve/case-normalize/stat each targetNamespacePath exactly once and store its identity/components in the resolved record; then perform O(P^2) pair comparisons purely in memory. Current namespacePathsOverlap calls namespaceIdentity(left/right) for every pair, causing O(P^2) filesystem stats. Per-pass O(P) filesystem reads should remove the hot path while still detecting symlink/ancestor/filesystem drift between writes. Remove declaration-only cross-save cache unless you can prove stronger equivalent invalidation. Add a test that changes an alias/symlink between consecutive saves and expects the second save to fail closed.
